name: What is the process for door installation with your company?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for door installation with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our door installation process begins with an initial consultation and on-site assessment to discuss your needs and measure existing openings. We then provide a detailed quote outlining material and labor costs. Once approved, we assist with door selection and ordering. On installation day, our team removes the old door, prepares the opening, installs the new door, ensures proper sealing and insulation, and finishes with trim work. We conclude with a final inspection to confirm your satisfaction and address any questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, on-site assessment, detailed quote, door selection, professional installation, and a final inspection to ensure satisfaction.
